nodes.description: Required node input. Each item must include file and structural_path. structural_path is one slash-separated structural path suffix, not a regex or glob. For same-file batches repeat the same file or use newline-separated structural_path values in one item.

file.description: Explicit source file path that owns the target function or method.

structural_path.description: Slash-separated structural path suffix such as main, UserService/get_user, impl MyType/new, or impl MyTrait for MyType/run.

max_nodes.description: Maximum node requests to process before marking the rest as skipped. Defaults to 20.
